biography: As a seasoned Preconstruction Manager with over 15 years in the construction industry, I specialize in turnkey concrete solutions for multi-family residential developments and mission-critical data centers. My expertise lies in leading preconstruction phases from conceptual estimating to bid finalization, ensuring projects are delivered on time, under budget, and with minimal risks. I've managed portfolios exceeding $25 million, focusing on value engineering, subcontractor coordination, and sustainable practices to optimize outcomes for clients. In multi-family projects, I've overseen turnkey concrete operations for high-rise apartments and mixed-use communities, achieving [e.g., 15% cost reductions through innovative formwork and material sourcing]. For data centers, my experience includes hyperscale facilities where precision in concrete foundations and structural integrity is paramount, resulting in [e.g., zero delays in 5+ projects due to proactive risk assessments]. Proficient in tools like Procore, Bluebeam, and Autodesk Revit, I collaborate with architects, engineers, and stakeholders to align designs with budgetary and regulatory demands. I'm passionate about mentoring teams and advancing industry standards.
